name: BSP_Bot_SubControllerForCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_attack_commands; docs/ATTACK_COMMANDS.md and reports/attack_commands.json. void* __thiscall(ECX = bot)(CommandClass* klass). Maps a class to a fixed offset inside the bot: stop +BD8h, cruise +BC8h, follow +BE4h, land +C38h, moveto +C5Ch, moveonpath +C64h, and artillery with attackmove sharing +C70h, or +217Ch/+2254h when bot+B0Ch is non-zero (chosen by 00779AA0). No other class has a slot. That artillery and attackmove share one is the AI-side confirmation of 00817229's rewrite. | Packet cc_exe_2n, read-only analysis, read whole: __thiscall(ai)(command object), RET 4, body 009F3D00-009F3DCE. A plain dispatch from a command singleton to the embedded state object, by ai offset (brain offset + 58h): 009F3D04 00E08F68 -> +0C5Ch movetopos, 009F3D1A 00E08FA0 -> +0C38h land, 009F3D29 00E08F88 -> +0BD8h stop, 009F3D38 00E08F80 -> +0C64h moveonpath, 009F3D47 00E08F60 -> +0BE4h follow, 009F3D64 00E08F70 -> +0BC8h cruise; 009F3D56/009F3D5D share one arm for 00E08F10 artillery and 00E08F78 attackmove, which reads [ai+0B0Ch] and, when it is non-null, asks 00779AA0 to choose +2254h kamikaze_attack over +217Ch sub_attack, and otherwise takes +0C70h attackmove; every other command falls to the stop state at 009F3DA0. On a change it calls the outgoing state's vtable[8] at 009F3DB9, stores the new one at ai+2264h and calls its vtable[4] at 009F3DC8. Run-time: bsp_game.exe milestone 2n installed cruise, stop, attackmove and movetopos states for usn_2_java's 32 ships through this routine. docs/SHIP_AI_STATES.md, docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md

name: BSP_ShipAi_DriveOrderRing
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Supersedes BSP_UnitBot_RequestLoadLevels (packet unit_command_producers), which named the routine for a side effect. void __thiscall(blk)(float dt), RET 4 at 009F4D04, body 009F3F80-009F4D06, only caller the tail call at 009F50C6 in 009F4DA0, unit at blk+3FCh. It is the AI's drive output: it reads the order-ring slot under the write cursor at 009F400D and 009F4025, rewrites blk+1D0h at ten sites and blk+1D4h through 009DA250, then at 009F4B99-009F4D04 zeroes the rudder inside the 0.05 throttle deadband (00D7A270), slews both values toward the ring slot by at most dt*1.5 (00CE3D78) and stores them back with 0080E190 (009F4CE8) and 0080E170 (009F4CFB). The six load-latch raises the old name described are still there. Packet cc_ai_throttle_ring, read-only. docs/SHIP_AI_THROTTLE_TO_RING.md | Run-time evidence, packet cc_exe_2o (bsp_game.exe milestone 2o): the executable now runs chain slot 16, so 009F50E0 -> 009F4DA0 -> 009F50C6 -> 009F3F80 executes 15680 times in a 490-step mission run and the tail writes the unit's own order ring write slot every step. Two branch facts read from the listing for that wiring and not in the earlier record: (1) 009F3FF2 JNZ 009F4D00 is the routine's ONLY early out and it skips the hop, gated on blk+3F5h, which nothing writes in this process (0 of 15680 gated); (2) the first 009DA250 store at 009F44FC is gated by 009F44E4 CMP [ESI+1C4h],0 / JZ 009F4502, so the rudder law runs only when the steering mode is not Rudder - 0 of 15680 steps opened it in this mission. Every other path converges on 009F4B99: the pops at 009F4BBF..009F4BC5 are unconditional and 009F4D04 is the single RET. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2o.

name: BSP_ShipAi_PublishOrderSlot
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_ai_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall(blk)(float seconds), RET 4, body 009F4D10-009F4D90, called at 009F5227. Writes the AI's order into the unit's 84-byte order slot at unit+0AECh-54h*[unit+0B40h]: 00811960 sets slot+44h from blk+324h, slot+40h=blk+32Ch, slot+48h=blk+330h, slot+4Ch=1. The base is the unit, proved by 0081F1EC storing the unit's own pointer at unit+0B3Ch (slot+50h) and 00825F5E writing the index. docs/UNIT_AUTOPILOT_PAIR.md | Run-time, packet cc_exe_2n: 15680 publishes over a 500-frame usn_2_java run, one per unit per fixed simulation step, through bsp::ship_ai_publish_order_009f4d10 with 00811960 at 009F4D48. Every publish set the slot's +4Ch flag and the motion head's promotion at 00825F2C consumed it on the same step, 15680 of 15680, flipping [unit+0B40h] and copying the slot through 00811D10. For a ship whose latched cruise thrust is zero the direct-control arm leaves the stopped-direction branch, so +40h and +48h are the stopping distance v*v/(2*Retardation) plus unit+9C8h, which is 0.0 at rest, and +44h is the unit's own heading corrected by 00811940's yaw rate. Nothing read the promoted slot: the ring at +148h/+14Ch was never written.
